def shift_(self, x=0, y=0):
    """Move this bounding box along the x/y-axis in-place.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x : int, optional
        Amount of pixels by which to shift this object along the x-axis.

    y : int, optional
        Amount of pixels by which to shift this object along the y-axis.

    Returns
    -------
    imgaug.augmentables.bbs.BoundingBox
        Shifted bounding box.
        The object may have been modified in-place.

    """
    self.x1 += x
    self.x2 += x
    self.y1 += y
    self.y2 += y
    return self
